svg.metadata: {"title": "Date tag", "description": "What it is, and its steps (bagged, frozen, opened ...): the first dated, the rest a line to write on.", "fields": {"item": {"default": "", "help": "what it is"}, "steps": {"default": ["Bagged", "Frozen", "Unfrozen", "Opened"], "type": "list"}, "date": {"default": "{{date}}", "help": "the first step's date (today)"}}, "example": {"item": "Bolognese, 2 portions", "steps": ["Cooked", "Frozen", "Thawed"]}}
